    Integral separation of finite families of class vectors #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.Farkas.common_denominator {I : Type u_1} [Fintype I] (v : I → ℚ) :
    ∃ (d : ℚ) (w : I → ℤ), 0 < d ∧ ∀ (i : I), ↑(w i) = d * v i
    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.Farkas.integral_separation_or_relation {n : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (B : I → Fin n → ℤ) (U : J → Fin n → ℤ) :
    (∃ (w : Fin n → ℤ), (∀ (i : I), ∑ t : Fin n, B i t * w t = 0) ∧ ∀ (j : J), ∑ t : Fin n, U j t * w t < 0) ∨ ∃ (a : J → ℤ) (c : I → ℤ), (∀ (j : J), 0 ≤ a j) ∧ 0 < ∑ j : J, a j ∧ ∀ (t : Fin n), ∑ j : J, a j * U j t = ∑ i : I, c i * B i t

    The alternative for integral rows has an integral separating functional or an integral certificate with nonnegative test-row coefficients.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.Farkas.integral_separation_of_injective_coordinates {G : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup G] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → G →+ ℤ) (hv : Function.Injective fun (x : G) (t : Fin n) => (v t) x) {I : Type u_2} {J : Type u_3} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (B : I → G) (U : J → G) :
    (∃ (w : Fin n → ℤ), (∀ (i : I), (∑ t : Fin n, w t • v t) (B i) = 0) ∧ ∀ (j : J), (∑ t : Fin n, w t • v t) (U j) < 0) ∨ ∃ (a : J → ℤ) (c : I → ℤ), (∀ (j : J), 0 ≤ a j) ∧ 0 < ∑ j : J, a j ∧ ∑ j : J, a j • U j = ∑ i : I, c i • B i

    A finite separating family of integer coordinates lifts the alternative to the original abelian group. The separating weight is an integral combination of the given coordinates.
